shutdown.lease_close: pool.gate.close() cancels only the current generation; keeps the sole model child
shutdown.gui_close: pool.close(); require pool.gate.shutdown(timeout=2.) == True before original runtime close
shutdown.failure: No fallback or automatic respawn; failed shutdown raises before writer release
shutdown.owned_process: Graceful STOP IPC, bounded wait, owned Popen.terminate, bounded wait; no force-kill
shutdown.construction: Proxy reaps startup failures; factory try/close covers pool and config construction after spawning

protocol.transport: Anonymous inherited AF_UNIX socketpair only; no ports, HTTP or audio files
protocol.frame_payload: Exactly 1280 bytes: 320 little-endian float32 samples; unchanged normalized 20ms input
protocol.ownership: Version/kind/generation/monotonic request sequence; incomplete reply buffering; cancelled reply exclusion
protocol.timeout: 60s initial model readiness; 500ms per reset/frame RPC; read cancellation polls at most 20ms
protocol.idle: No one-hour process expiry; idle socket receive waits without creating audio/model work

model.instances: Exactly one BoardFftSpeechGate created inside the explicit Python child; none in parent
model.child_nice_verified: Before model initialization and on every response

tests.scope: Real socketpair/protocol and original BoardFrontendPool, fake model/process wrapper; no ARM/POSIX spawn, microphone or model inference acceptance
coverage: One gate model reused across leases, fixed frame serialization and scalar metrics
Cancellation before late result, discarded old-generation reply and clean next lease
Partial header/body cancellation buffering and payload bound
Timeout, model error, owner mismatch, startup failure, priority failure and changed priority
Default/explicit baseline selection; no combined process mode
Real GUI close method ordering and failed shutdown blocks runtime release
Actual constructor config rejection after worker creation invokes original cleanup
Python 3.9 AST and original pool/queue source remains untouched

limitations: The GTK-process raw producer, consumer scheduling and RPC serialization still require parent GIL time
Process separation is a hypothesis to test, not a throughput or real-time acceptance claim
Root must verify ARM subprocess/pass_fds/import/nice and owned process teardown before normal GUI publication
No BargeCapture protocol changes or extra model/queue/player are introduced
